item.title: Fresh Water Fishing Hall of Famer headlines Fish Tales Lecture Series
item.description: By Coggin Heeringa, Crossroads at Big Creek -- Crossroads at Big Creek is honored to host Lee Kernen for a special Fish Tales Lecture titled, "How Did Pacific Salmon Find Their Way to Door County?" on Thursday, Feb. 26, at 7 p.m.

item.title: Bare fields? Farmers hope cover crops are doing their jobs underground
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Fields that typically turn green after harvest looked more brown this fall, but farmers like Aaron Augustian hope appearances can be deceiving.

item.title: Green Bay Austin Straubel Airport receives national award

item.title: Door County Rocks Spreads Kindness across the Peninsula

item.title: Repair Café Brings Community Together for Sustainable Fixes
